surfaces.home: Choose Agent, a game or Minecraft without repeating navigation.
surfaces.agent: Work in a conversation with visible model, effort and actual task state.
surfaces.games: Discover before login; authenticate every room operation.
surfaces.minecraft: Copy the address and find verified installation information.
surfaces.account: Understand sign-in methods, recovery and active devices.

rules: No fabricated status, model capability, release validation or progress.
Public summaries never reuse authenticated card builders.
Personal persona and style apply only to the owning web user.
Model metadata may be unknown; missing capability flags are not a negative assertion.
A queued or running request is never automatically replayed after an ambiguous failure.
Preview data is explicitly labeled and never persisted as account state.
